current_intention: A short-range heavy horizontal strike with Broken Bones.
proposed_action: Set the weapon beside the rear hip, coil shoulders, then drive one broad horizontal cut. Keep the weapon plane aligned with the actual attack rather than the existing diagonal pose.
event_contract: Cross the strike plane when the existing melee damage snapshot runs. Preserve current wind-up scaling, equipment checks and input locks.
ascended_difference: Mercenary Ascension: stronger, longer-reaching strike and on-hit Hyper Armor. Broaden the follow-through; do not add a combo, extra strike or unconditional armor grant.

current_intention: Launch a ground-following shockwave along the aimed path.
proposed_action: Lower the blade or club near the rear hip, sink through the knees and cut upward through the ground-facing release line. Let the torso open as the wave leaves.
event_contract: STROKE_RELEASE starts the wave. Terrain following, travel and target hits remain in the projectile routine.
ascended_difference: Sword Master Ascension adds the returning path aftershock. One initial body stroke only; the aftershock is a world effect, not another swing.

current_intention: A brief close-range punch that stuns eligible Small enemies.
proposed_action: Tuck the main elbow, turn the shoulder forward and punch straight through the target plane. Off hand protects the chest; feet do not slide forward.
event_contract: PUNCH_CONTACT at the existing post-wind-up hit. Use a render-only weapon accommodation if necessary; no inventory or hitbox changes.
ascended_difference: No dedicated Ascended version in the current kit.

current_intention: Repeated forward crescent waves; the caster actively releases each main wave.
proposed_action: Alternate short horizontal cuts without returning to idle. For the large final wave, settle into a deeper side chamber, briefly hold, then drive a wider horizontal finish.
event_contract: Each actual main-wave spawn receives one CUT_RELEASE. Use current per-wave intervals and final wind-up; do not reuse the same full wind-up before every cut.
ascended_difference: Four fast waves, a larger fifth, then its afterimage in this build. The afterimage repeats the effect silhouette without making an extra damage-owning player swing.

current_intention: A single cast dispatches a fan of upright traveling cleaves.
proposed_action: Coil into a broad side sweep, extending the main hand toward the center of the fan. Add a small second wrist/shoulder accent for the delayed gap-filling fan.
event_contract: First and second fan-release callbacks own their cleave counts. Thirteen projectiles do not mean thirteen full-body swings.
ascended_difference: Seven initial cleaves and six gap-fill cleaves, with fire trails and Burn. The trails continue independently; preserve current delay and burn logic.

current_intention: Spend a charge to create a sphere of cuts at the aimed location.
proposed_action: Bring the blade near the opposite hip, make one quick outward draw and finish in a narrow guard. Remote cuts answer the gesture; the player stays where they are.
event_contract: One DRAW_RELEASE per accepted cast/charge. Do not create a persistent player-centered spinning hitbox or require a real sheath.
ascended_difference: More charges and an extra remote cut per cast. Reuse exactly the same body action.

current_intention: A committed forward thrust dash.
proposed_action: Pull the sword near the ribs with point aimed forward, lean into the dash, then extend through the thrust. Recover from the actual endpoint with knees absorbing momentum.
event_contract: Preserve existing wind-up, dash path, collision policy and attack cancellation. The thrust endpoint is not inferred from clip length.
ascended_difference: Shorter wind-up, greater distance and width. Time-scale the entry and hold the drive; no added leap or spinning finisher.

current_intention: An enlarged magical blade cuts all around the caster.
proposed_action: Coil across the body and pivot through one full horizontal sweep, keeping the enlarged spectral blade outside the torso. Finish facing the legal combat direction.
event_contract: Bind the sweep to the existing radial hit event. Cosmetic blade arc does not add repeated contacts.
ascended_difference: Larger radius and an eligible-projectile reflection window. Tie the visible defensive arc to that exact existing window.

variant: Paired cuts, optional held spin finish
current_intention: Two scheduled large slashes; current Ascension adds an input-controlled finisher.
proposed_action: Perform the current paired horizontal cuts. In Ascension, settle into the existing pulled-back stance; when the permitted Left Click arrives, flow into a strong spin cut and release the large wave.
event_contract: Preserve both scheduled slash events, stance eligibility, timeout/cancel and separate finisher input. Do not automatically fire the optional finisher.
ascended_difference: Current build uses a held stance and large Free Aim Ghost wave, not the earlier three slow persistent laser proposal. Match current code.

current_intention: A radial party mobility/stamina Grace.
proposed_action: Briefly salute with the free hand or weapon, then open the forearm to send the blessing outward. Stay upright and ready to move.
event_contract: BUFF_APPLY remains immediate at its current callback. Long buff duration does not hold the salute.
ascended_difference: No separate Ascended Grace in the current kit.

current_intention: A local stomp followed by outward ground shocks.
proposed_action: Shift onto the supporting leg, raise the striking knee modestly and stamp down hard. Let the knees and shoulders settle once while the shock travels away.
event_contract: First stomp impact aligns with FOOT_CONTACT. Later shocks remain centered on their original world position, not the player after moving away.
ascended_difference: A third wider impact is an effect-only continuation. No three stomps or additional locks.

current_intention: A full-circle weapon swing with movement during preparation.
proposed_action: Carry the weapon across the rear shoulder while walking, then pivot through the swing. Blend the upper-body coil over locomotion until the actual sweep.
event_contract: Preserve full permitted walking speed during wind-up. Each actual swing gets its existing radial hit; visual rotation does not add hits.
ascended_difference: Two consecutive full swings. Chain directly into the second with its existing gap; launch eligibility remains damage/status logic.

current_intention: Leap and land with a heavy radial impact.
proposed_action: Use the same horizontal aerial roll and main-hand superhero landing as Electric Smite. Give the final compression a heavier physical weight; use dust, fractures and ground shock instead of lightning.
event_contract: Ground contact, not roll completion, authorizes impact. Preserve the current jump steering and landing routine. Keep the fist above ground until contact.
ascended_difference: One delayed ground shock after landing. Reuse the impact settle; do not force a second jump or replace the resumed attack with merc_aftershock.

current_intention: A weapon-driven ground fissure ending in an explosion.
proposed_action: Lift the weapon over the main shoulder, set the hips and slam down along the aim line. Keep the visual impact near the caster while the fissure travels to the endpoint.
event_contract: STROKE_RELEASE starts the line. The distant endpoint explosion follows the existing effect timing; no second caster hit.
ascended_difference: Longer travel and stronger endpoint/control effects. Same motion, current scaled timings.

current_intention: Bat a bomb into flight; it bursts on first physical contact.
proposed_action: Stage a summoned bomb near the strike path, coil as for a bat swing and sweep the held implement through the launch plane. The bomb departs in the aimed direction.
event_contract: Projectile spawn/release uses the existing cast callback. First collision, gravity and explosion remain projectile-owned; no extra melee swing damage.
ascended_difference: Larger explosion and persistent ground fire. Same single bat motion; fire ticks do not replay the swing.

current_intention: A sustained spinning melee attack.
proposed_action: Enter with a tight coil, extend weapons into a stable repeated spin and decelerate into a sweep at exit where supported. Keep turn count continuous rather than snapping backward.
event_contract: Spin loop follows actual active duration. Damage ticks are independent of frame rate/number of visual revolutions. End early on the existing cancellation rules.
ascended_difference: Longer channel, Hyper Armor and a final sweep built by actual spin time. Final sweep visual occurs only when the existing mechanic grants it.

current_intention: A radial damage Grace for allies.
proposed_action: Compress the chest, draw elbows inward, then spread shoulders and roar with weapon held safely away. Return to combat stance without repeated shaking.
event_contract: BUFF_APPLY at current acceptance; visual follow-through cannot delay allies receiving it.
ascended_difference: No separate Ascended Grace. The smaller Fury proc variant must not hijack an active cast.

current_intention: Release a forward cone of lightning that applies the current Zap mechanics.
proposed_action: Snap the main palm forward from a short elbow chamber. Show lightning expanding forward in a cone, with the shield staying defensive.
event_contract: Current damage/effect is immediate even though the pose has a small lead-in. Use release-first alignment; retain the existing short skill lock rather than adding another wind-up.
ascended_difference: No dedicated class-skill Ascension in the current branches. Existing Zap interactions remain unchanged.

current_intention: Call vertical holy lightning onto the aimed ground.
proposed_action: Lift the main hand above the head and drag it down toward the target. The bolt descends at the remote point, not horizontally from the hand.
event_contract: CAST_RELEASE commits the strike after current wind-up. Any trail/follow-up events remain in their current world routines.
ascended_difference: Paladin class Ascension uses the larger strike/trail treatment. Keep one grounded call gesture; do not borrow Electric Smite’s leap.

current_intention: A radial heal with an Ascended ally-target option.
proposed_action: Normal: chest gather into an open palm and radial wave. Ascended targeted use: reach a gentle palm toward the chosen ally, then recover; self fallback retains Wavecaller.
event_contract: Healing occurs at the current callback. Correct the caster animation to that event; do not delay instant healing or move the effect center to the hand.
ascended_difference: Priest class Ascension switches the applicable targeted gesture/source behavior. It is the same underlying Cleric identity, not a separately styled base-class tree.

current_intention: Summon a large holy Cross that descends onto the remote target.
proposed_action: Use the shared Sky Command: gather at chest, raise main hand, then direct it down toward the placement point. Recover while the Cross is falling.
event_contract: Separate cast release, falling-object arrival and ground impact. Keep the existing indoor-safe height and drop-time calculation.
ascended_difference: Use the same cast with the current Ascended relic effects. Additional world effects do not require a new animation.

current_intention: Hurl a growing holy hammer; Ascension enables its return.
proposed_action: Coil the main shoulder, pitch the summoned hammer overarm and follow across the chest. On actual return, open the hand toward it and absorb a small catch recoil.
event_contract: PROJECTILE_RELEASE and RETURN_CONTACT are separate. Only catch if it really returns. Do not remove the equipped weapon from inventory.
ascended_difference: Adds a return/catch overlay, not a second throwing cast or guaranteed catch on interrupted/failed returns.

current_intention: Charge with the shield forward, retaining current steering and bash handling.
proposed_action: Lower the hips, put the off-hand shield ahead of the chest and hold the main weapon behind the shield rim. Drive continuously; finish with a short shield shove when the real bash occurs.
event_contract: Align entry to charge start, looping posture to actual movement, and bash to its separate event. Retain existing collision and distance budget.
ascended_difference: Current enhanced effects use the same drive and bash phases. No borrowed invulnerability or Ghost collision from sword movement.

current_intention: Angel Comet rises and then drives down toward the target.
proposed_action: Open into the current ascent, align torso along the dive and streamline the limbs. At real contact, rotate hips under the torso and brace the main hand/guard safely.
event_contract: Ascent, dive start and ground contact follow the movement routine. Landing pose must already be prepared when damage occurs.
ascended_difference: Holy ground fire after impact needs no prolonged landing hold. Keep this head-leading dive distinct from Olympic Hero’s long-axis roll.

current_intention: A radial restorative/empowering wave that also affects enemies.
proposed_action: Raise the main palm softly, then open the arm outward from the chest with a clear protective silhouette. Preserve shield grip and combat readiness.
event_contract: One radial application at the current callback, with healing/damage/status handling left intact. No forward beam despite the name Ray.
ascended_difference: Barrier/cleanse treatment uses the same gesture and stronger effect accent; no new channel.

current_intention: Leap and slam down, sending sixteen lightning trails over the ground.
proposed_action: Compress, launch, tilt almost horizontal and rotate once around the head-to-feet axis. Unwind before contact; main fist hits first in a superhero landing with opposite foot forward.
event_contract: Actual GROUND_CONTACT synchronizes fist, impact cue and trail launch. Preserve sixteen ground trails and their shared hit rules; no timer-driven premature impact.
ascended_difference: Storm effects after landing remain world effects. Same complete Olympic Hero motion for normal and Ascended; no repeated fist impacts per lightning tick.

current_intention: A radial defense/equipment-mobility Grace.
proposed_action: Cross the available forearm toward the chest then open into a protective blessing. A shield can rise slightly as the wave expands.
event_contract: BUFF_APPLY remains the single current event. Long defense duration does not hold the animation.
ascended_difference: No separate Ascended Grace.

current_intention: A falling remote Cross becomes a persistent offensive relic.
proposed_action: Use exactly Goddess Relic’s Sky Command with the appropriate equipment profile. For a dismiss/relinquish recast, close the palm using Rift Conductor instead of replaying a summon.
event_contract: Release, fall, placement and recurring pulse are separate. Pulses cannot restart the caster animation; keep the existing replacement/recast logic.
ascended_difference: Enhanced relic behavior changes the world effect only. Shared relic combinations stay current; this pass does not redesign Sanctified interactions.

current_intention: A remote restorative Cross descends and supports nearby allies.
proposed_action: Use the same Sky Command pose, timing structure and equipment rules as Goddess/Lightning Relic. Make the effect warmer and gentler, not the body choreography unrelated.
event_contract: The implementation summons from above despite planting language in some descriptions. Do not animate manually pushing a Cross into the caster’s ground.
ascended_difference: Enhanced support and paired-relic effects run independently. Recast dismissal uses the same short closing palm as Lightning Relic.

current_intention: A holy burst around the caster or an aimed relic.
proposed_action: Gather and open the main hand while looking toward the chosen source. Keep the body at the caster position; the wave originates at the actual source.
event_contract: CAST_RELEASE activates the existing selected-source burst. A distant relic target does not teleport the caster or require a projectile from the hand.
ascended_difference: Additional relic-source coverage needs effect duplication only, not multiple full-body gestures.

current_intention: Two crossing slashes create a traveling radiant X.
proposed_action: Cut diagonally across the torso, reverse through a short chamber, then cut along the opposite diagonal. Let the two spectral planes form the X beyond the hands.
event_contract: Use both existing slash timings and the current X projectile spawn logic. Keep the held implement coherent through both grips.
ascended_difference: Enlargement/other current projectile changes preserve the two-cut performance. Do not restore an obsolete endpoint explosion.

current_intention: Holy beams strike around the caster or an aimed relic source.
proposed_action: Raise the main hand with an open palm and pull it down decisively toward the chosen area. Recover while the barrage continues.
event_contract: One initiating CAST_RELEASE; later beam impacts and final effects remain remote callbacks. Retain original area source selection.
ascended_difference: The additional final column is a world event. Do not interrupt a later player action with another forced sky call.

current_intention: Create a sustained storm field with repeated lightning effects.
proposed_action: Use the large Sky Command variant: wider reach and a stronger downward command, followed by immediate legal recovery.
event_contract: Storm creation is the release event. Repeated bolts do not require holding both arms overhead for the whole field duration.
ascended_difference: A following/moving storm changes field tracking, not caster locomotion or posture duration.

current_intention: Heaven’s Crucible wraps allies in a persistent barrier.
proposed_action: Gather forearms near the chest and open outward into a protective dome cue. Finish in the same combat-ready guard as Heaven’s Light.
event_contract: Barrier creation follows the existing wind-up/application. Breaking or refreshing a barrier is not a new caster animation unless there is a real recast.
ascended_difference: No separate Ascended Grace. Preserve internal ID grand_sigil.

current_intention: A short forward cone of fire.
proposed_action: Chamber the casting arm or staff slightly, then push directly toward the crosshair. Keep the cone forward and the off hand available for the current equipment.
event_contract: Use the actual branch’s scaled wind-up, including zero-wind-up Horizon Walker. Immediate variants begin at release; preserve existing input restrictions.
ascended_difference: No dedicated Ascended class-skill version.

current_intention: Drop an ice impact onto aimed ground.
proposed_action: Lift the staff or main palm, hold a compact overhead silhouette, then direct the falling ice onto the target. The caster does not slam their own feet.
event_contract: Fit to existing scaled cast timing and remote impact callback. Zero-wind-up branch uses a short release-first command.
ascended_difference: Archmage Ascension enlarges the impact and central effect. Same gesture with a weightier release accent; no extra cast.

current_intention: Raise damaging stone fangs at aimed ground.
proposed_action: Base planted version: lower center of mass and press staff butt or palm downward to command the eruption. Horizon Walker: use only a quick downward wrist command while retaining stride/air pose.
event_contract: Remote eruption remains at the aimed point. Do not force the caster to that location or add a ground-contact requirement to an airborne-legal cast.
ascended_difference: Persistent spikes keep ticking after the initial command. They do not repeatedly stamp the caster or hold them in place.

current_intention: Hold to strengthen a meteor aimed at the ground.
proposed_action: Gather, lift the implement high and hold a quiet call pose while aim remains adjustable. Pull down at release, then recover as the meteor falls.
event_contract: Charge begins alongside the current wind-up. Maintain hold until actual release/cancel, including time spent at maximum charge; do not use the pose driver’s fixed hold timeout as the release signal.
ascended_difference: Small follow-up meteors are automatic world events, including the larger count at full charge. No extra body casts per meteor.

current_intention: Create a remote persistent gravitational field.
proposed_action: Reach toward the target, spread the fingers around an imagined sphere and pull the hand inward as the field establishes. Settle while the field continues.
event_contract: Keep the actual wind-up. Field pulse and pull ticks are independent of caster hand motion; preserve the selected world center.
ascended_difference: Larger, longer field and ending explosion. The final explosion does not force a delayed arm-clench during another skill.

current_intention: Assemble and fire an aimed magical beam.
proposed_action: Brace the implement along the crosshair, shoulders behind the emission line. Release with restrained recoil; sustained version holds that aim posture and follows permitted aim changes.
event_contract: Normal: one SHOT_RELEASE. Ascended: BEAM_START, continuous current aiming/damage logic, then BEAM_END. No recoil on every damage tick.
ascended_difference: Four-second steerable beam in the current build. One entry and exit; interruption must clear hold/root ownership without firing an extra final beam.

current_intention: Slam a giant astral blade along the current aim.
proposed_action: Raise the casting implement as if taking the weight of a giant sword, then drive downward. Recoil into a ready overhead chamber for the next real slam.
event_contract: Each authoritative slam gets one aligned STROKE_RELEASE. Re-aim according to existing code. Correct any pose starting after the slam rather than delaying the hit.
ascended_difference: Three slams, no charge. Existing old altar wording about charging is stale; do not restore charging from it.

current_intention: Release a radial frost burst around the caster.
proposed_action: Compress the chest and elbows, then sharply open both available arms with a stable stance. Show a circular frost release, not a aimed cone.
event_contract: NOVA_RELEASE follows current scaled wind-up. Persistent aura ticks and final burst remain separate from the caster pose.
ascended_difference: Frost Aura lasts independently, then explodes. Do not hold a six-second open-arm pose or reintroduce the removed shaking.

current_intention: Charge a large targeted elemental area attack.
proposed_action: Lift both available arms/implement into the widest Sky Command silhouette, hold calmly while charge builds and drive downward when released.
event_contract: Preserve existing minimum wind-up, charge overlap and release input. Target detonation is a world event, not a requirement for the caster to hit the ground.
ascended_difference: Second bombardment at the original area is automatic. Same one cast; no Overcharge refund or added gesture.

current_intention: A radial skill/cooldown Grace.
proposed_action: Turn the free wrist as if setting a small clock, then open the forearm into the shared blessing pulse. Keep this insert short and equipment-compatible.
event_contract: BUFF_APPLY remains immediate at its current callback. No cast-time penalty for the decorative clock gesture.
ascended_difference: No separate Ascended Grace.

current_intention: Summon hovering swords, fire individually, or arm and launch a full volley.
proposed_action: Open the available hand to array the swords. For individual releases use a small finger/implement accent only when arms are free. Recast uses a distinct closing/pointing command to arm the volley.
event_contract: Keep summon, recast-to-arm and the next fresh Mouse1-to-fire separate. Do not launch on the recast itself or let cosmetics consume normal weapon input.
ascended_difference: Eight swords and impact spears for the full volley. Spears are a remote effect; no player ground-stomp or four additional attacks.

current_intention: Create spectral copies that reproduce supported attacks.
proposed_action: Flick the free hand outward to leave or summon a copy, while retaining the current stride and aim. A hold-all input uses the same open-hand finish once its actual summon event occurs.
event_contract: Keep individual summon timers, hold behavior and clone lifetime logic. Clone attacks use their own mirrored weapon poses; they never retrigger the player’s summon gesture.
ascended_difference: Current Ascended copies follow and mirror supported weapon attacks. Do not implement the earlier proposed all-skill copying as part of an animation pass.

current_intention: Teleport without stopping the action underway.
proposed_action: Keep the current shooting/stride pose, add a tiny directional lean or just disappearance VFX, and reappear in the same action phase.
event_contract: Teleport commits at the existing callback. No anticipatory crouch, recovery lock or travel interpolation. Preserve current featherfall and momentum policy.
ascended_difference: Two charges and retained momentum. Reuse the same transition; no damaging departure rift.

current_intention: Open rifts behind the target that echo attacks.
proposed_action: Indicate the target with a brief finger or implement tip movement, then continue firing. Rifts open behind the target, not as barrels attached to the player’s hands.
event_contract: One accepted command, independent echo timing afterward. If both hands are firing, use a head/wrist/VFX-only accent to avoid interrupting the weapon animation.
ascended_difference: Current build opens three rifts; it is not merely the older cadence-change proposal. No three separate caster gestures.

current_intention: Launch a traveling gravity orb with current recast controls.
proposed_action: Push the orb out with Pulse Drive. Use an open stopping hand for its stop command and a compact pinch for a detonation command where supported.
event_contract: Keep initial cast and each recast state separate. Do not collapse the orb early because the launch animation ended.
ascended_difference: Longer travel and stronger stop burst follow current branch logic. Reuse the command states without inventing or removing recast inputs.

current_intention: Spend a charge to trigger a delayed rupture at aimed ground while moving.
proposed_action: Snap the available wrist toward the selected point and continue locomotion. Let the target telegraph build independently before the explosion.
event_contract: COMMAND_ACCEPTED occurs now; TARGET_DETONATION follows its existing delay. That delay is not a full-body caster wind-up or root lock.
ascended_difference: More charges and stronger explosions use the same gesture. Preserve recast buffer; no queued gesture spam during target delays.

current_intention: Place two linked portals and traverse with the existing interaction.
proposed_action: Open the available hand toward each placement point using Rift Conductor. Traversal uses Ghost Step, preserving the walking/attack phase through the transition.
event_contract: PORTAL_A, PORTAL_B and TELEPORT_COMMIT are distinct. Do not teleport immediately on placing the second portal or change the E interaction.
ascended_difference: No separate Ascended Grace. Portals stay visually independent of the short caster gesture.

current_intention: A straight piercing arrow with current first-hit control.
proposed_action: Use a clean forward aim and sharp string release, left bow arm stable. Retain one recoil source and quickly return the right hand toward its next legal draw.
event_contract: Current projectile starts immediately. Begin at loose rather than adding a new draw delay; impacts remain arrow-owned.
ascended_difference: Longer range, widening flight and Expose use the same shot. The growth does not stretch the bow or caster.

current_intention: Retreat in a backflip and shoot a forward fan at the apex.
proposed_action: Compress, spring backward and tuck into a true backward somersault. Keep the bow in the left hand; fire toward the threat at the existing apex event and extend legs to land.
event_contract: Current shared travel is about 0.3s and apex about 0.15s. Align visual phase to movement instead of slowing gameplay for a longer flourish.
ascended_difference: Wider fan, cooldown reset conditions and departure gust do not add another flip or a second damage-owning release.

current_intention: Place a ground snare at the selected valid location.
proposed_action: Lower through the knees, briefly dispatch/place with the free hand and rise. Use a wrist-only command when casting in the air as Acrobat.
event_contract: TRAP_PLACED matches current placement; activation by an enemy is a later world event. Do not move the player to a remote target.
ascended_difference: No dedicated Ascended version in the current kit.

current_intention: Spring backward while firing a wide wind-powered arrow fan.
proposed_action: Reuse Tumble Shot’s entire Rebound Shot sequence. Different arrow spread, wind and recoil accent communicate the stronger shot.
event_contract: Same shared BackFlip movement/apex event contract; preserve collision-shortened travel and current invulnerability timing.
ascended_difference: A second arcing fan gets a second short firing accent at its scheduled event, possibly during landing. Never add a second flip.

current_intention: Fire a slow moving cyclone projectile.
proposed_action: Release the arrow immediately from the aim pose. A compact torso/foot pivot can follow as cosmetic recovery where grounded; airborne version keeps the flight pose.
event_contract: Do not make the player wait for the existing spin-loose choreography before the projectile appears. Projectile rotation and pulling are independent.
ascended_difference: Split cyclones on first catch are effect-only. The caster does not become a sustained whirlwind or fire three new shots.

current_intention: An aimed dash cuts enemies along its path.
proposed_action: Streamline body along aim with bow tight against the torso, then unfold into the exit. Use a grounded compression only when actually landing.
event_contract: Match current short dash duration, wall stop and exit velocity. An airborne dash finishes in air; it must not wait for a landing animation.
ascended_difference: Three charges and a delayed wind slash along the path. Reuse the dive once per accepted charge; delayed slash is not another dash.

current_intention: Rise, hover and shoot down into the area below.
proposed_action: Use Rebound Shot’s launch/flip module with the existing longer ascent, then settle into Sky Archer’s down-aim hover. Alternate small draw/release accents while hovering.
event_contract: Preserve the current ascent, ceiling check and real hover-shot cadence. On hover end, blend to falling before any grounded recovery.
ascended_difference: Steer the larger ground circle with permitted aim controls. Do not rotate the whole body through another flip for every shot.

current_intention: One arrow bounces through multiple targets.
proposed_action: Angle the shoulders into a relaxed side-on trick-shot silhouette, loose one clean arrow and reset. Keep the grip mechanically plausible rather than tossing the bow.
event_contract: One SHOT_RELEASE. All bounces and damage escalation are projectile logic, not separate player shots.
ascended_difference: More bounces and a final explosion add no caster actions.

current_intention: Maintain a leaf storm/barrier while spinning.
proposed_action: Use Cyclone’s continuous body rotation with bow held close or safely extended, keeping a stable center rather than flailing the arms. Exit into a readable open sweep.
event_contract: Loop only for the actual active duration. Leaves, barrier checks and damage ticks remain independent of visual turns.
ascended_difference: Larger field/duration and final gale use the existing end event; no extra rooted flourish after movement is allowed.

current_intention: A radial movement/jump/fall-protection Grace.
proposed_action: Lift the free forearm as if catching an updraft, then open outward into the shared wave. Keep the bow in the left hand.
event_contract: Buff applies at the current callback. No repeated bobbing or shaking throughout the buff.
ascended_difference: No separate Ascended Grace.

current_intention: Hold a powerful piercing bow or crossbow shot.
proposed_action: Set a wide stable firing posture, draw and hold with controlled breathing. Release with one heavy shoulder recoil, then return to aim. Crossbow uses a braced trigger profile.
event_contract: Charge and fire follow current hold/release input. Holding at maximum charge must not be auto-released by the pose driver timeout.
ascended_difference: Full-charge pierce explosions remain target events. They do not trigger repeated recoil or new projectiles from the caster.

current_intention: Initiate an arrow bombardment over the selected area.
proposed_action: Angle the bow or crossbow skyward, show the initiating release and lower back to normal aim. Start at the release key for the current instant cast.
event_contract: One SKY_RELEASE creates the field. Falling arrows and damage ticks continue after the caster recovers.
ascended_difference: Frozen-arrow effects change the bombardment, not caster choreography.

current_intention: A precise immobilizing/control arrow with current target rules.
proposed_action: Sink slightly at the knees while keeping the weapon level and loose one deliberate shot. A full kneel is optional only if it fits current restrictions and real leg support exists.
event_contract: Current release is immediate. Do not delay firing until a cinematic kneel finishes or invent an extra stationary lock.
ascended_difference: Additional nearby targets are effect handling, not three full player shots.

current_intention: Fire one projectile that explodes on impact.
proposed_action: Brace the weapon, loose sharply and absorb a small shoulder kick. Recover without letting the bow arm collapse or the crossbow float from its stock grip.
event_contract: One SHOT_RELEASE and later PROJECTILE_CONTACT. Only one recoil owner; no camera/bone double recoil.
ascended_difference: Ground fire and cluster bombs are remote continuations. Do not make the player throw additional bombs.

current_intention: A planted rapid volley sequence aimed through a cone.
proposed_action: Hold a stable lower stance and alternate small torso aim sweeps and string-hand resets. Chain releases directly without returning to idle.
event_contract: One release accent per existing volley callback. Preserve its current planted movement restriction and exact interval, including fast Ascended cadence.
ascended_difference: Five rapid volleys and stacking Burn. Time-compress the draw/reset, not the projectile count or cadence.

current_intention: Channel to call a large arrow bombardment.
proposed_action: Raise the weapon toward the sky, hold a deliberate charge silhouette during the existing channel, then loose and return to guard while arrows fall.
event_contract: CHANNEL_COMPLETE initiates the remote bombardment. Do not play one full actor shot per decorative falling arrow or per enemy damaged.
